p168157293.desc:
Olasor Holiday Homes is proud to present this elegantly curated 2-bedroom residence within the prestigious Radisson Blu Hotel Apartments, Dubai Marina. This is luxury hotel-style living, reimagined for the modern resident who demands world-class service and a turnkey waterfront lifestyle.

The Olasor Lifestyle at Radisson Blu:
At Olasor, we don't just offer apartments; we curate sanctuaries. This 2-bedroom residence combines the sophistication of a 5-star hotel with the warm, expansive feel of a private home.

Why This Property is "Unreal":

Turnkey Luxury: Fully furnished with high-quality finishes and modern interiors—ready for immediate move-in.

The Marina Pulse: Strategically located steps away from Marina Walk and JBR Beach.

5-Star Amenities: Residents enjoy full access to the temperature-controlled pool, premium fitness center, and sauna/steam facilities.

On-Site Dining: Direct access to signature restaurants and cafés within the building.

Olasor Service: Dedicated concierge support and optional professional housekeeping to keep your home in "Showroom Condition."

Apartment Highlights:
Bright Living Spaces: Floor-to-ceiling windows offering iconic Marina views and abundant natural light.

Gourmet Kitchen: Fully equipped with high-end appliances and designer cabinetry.

Master Sanctuary: King-size bedroom with built-in wardrobes and an en-suite spa-style bathroom.

Second Suite: Spacious layout, perfect for guests, family, or a high-end home office.

Convenience: Includes 1 secure covered parking space and 24/7 on-site security.

Location: The Heart of the Marina
Live where the city meets the sea. You are walking distance to:

The Dubai Tram & Metro (Seamless city connectivity).

JBR Beach (The ultimate weekend escape).

Marina Walk (Over 7km of waterfront dining and retail).

Supermarkets & Essential Services (Right at your doorstep).

About Olasor Holiday Homes
We are more than a management company; we are curators of experience. Olasor specializes

b11849184.desc:
Experience stylish comfort in the heart of Dubai Marina at Radisson Blu Residence, where modern living meets breathtaking Marina views. 

Make Dubai Marina your home with this spacious and fully furnished two-bedroom hotel apartment at Radisson Blu Residence. Designed for long-term comfort and convenience, this modern apartment offers a unique blend of hotel-style service and the privacy of home—ideal for families, professionals, or business travellers. 
Enjoy panoramic city or Marina views, a fully equipped open kitchen, stylish interiors, and access to premium on-site amenities, all in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations. You're just steps away from JBR Beach, Marina Walk, Dubai Marina Mall, Bluewaters Island, and Ain Dubai, with seamless connectivity to Media City, Internet City, JLT, JAFZA, and metro/tram stations. 

Booking Terms:• Payment flexibility: Up to 6 cheques accepted
• Refundable security deposit: AED 5,000
• NO Commission

Rate Inclusions:• 10% service charge, 7% municipality fee, 5% VAT, and Tourism Dirham
• High-speed Wi-Fi
• DEWA utilities
• Free parking slot
• Daily housekeeping refresh (trash removal)
• Full housekeeping service twice a week
• Complimentary coffee & tea amenities and bathroom supplies (replenished twice a week)
• Access to the outdoor swimming pool and a fully equipped gym

Room Features and Amenities:• Fully furnished apartment with a balcony
• Marina or city views
• Fully equipped open kitchen with complete kitchenware
• Dishwasher, refrigerator, stovetop, oven, toaster, microwave
• Coffee machine and electric kettle
• Washing/drying machine
• Smart flat-screen TV
• Hairdryer, iron, ironing board, clothes rack
• In-room safe
• Sofa and dining area
• Soundproofing for privacy and comfort

Enjoy Hotel-Style Benefits Year-Round:• 40% discount on dry cleaning services
• 20% off food & beverages at Zaroob Restaurant
• Extra bed available (on request)
• Free baby cot (on request)

Radisson RewardsEarn 2 Radisson Reward Points for every USD 1 spent on accommodation charges (before taxes). Enjoy exclusive benefits and rewards with every stay. 

Book now and enjoy a full year of elevated living in Dubai Marina—where luxury, location, and lifestyle come together.
